origin.usage:
na.aggregate(object, ...)
na.aggregate.default(object, by = 1, ..., FUN = mean, na.rm = FALSE, maxgap = Inf)

arguments.name: by
arguments.text: Group ids recycled to the series, or a function of the time index.

arguments.name: FUN
arguments.text: Applied to the non-missing values in each group. The default is the mean.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, trim remaining missing values.

arguments.name: maxgap
arguments.text: Only gaps no longer than maxgap are replaced.

origin.details: Each missing value is replaced by FUN of the non-missing values in its group. The default group is the whole series and FUN is the mean. A group with no observations yields NaN from mean, not NA.
origin.value: The mean of 1 and 3 is 2, so c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA) returns 1, 2, 3, 2, 2.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
stopifnot(packageVersion("zoo") == "1.9-1")
x <- na.aggregate(c(1, NA, 3, NA, NA))
cat(paste(vapply(as.numeric(x), function(v) if (is.nan(v)) "NaN" else if (is.na(v)) "NA" else sprintf("%.12g", v), ""), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")
